"""정규화 후보의 8 CPU 실패 재현과 4·8 CPU 전체 입력 교차 비교를 보존한다."""
import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/Users/macbookair/Desktop/K-aption_BE')
from scripts.evaluate_cpu_translation_threads import server_state,configure,run_condition,docker
from scripts.evaluate_cpu_stt_options import save_new
root=Path('/Users/macbookair/Desktop/K-aption_BE')
directory=Path('/private/tmp/kaption-operator-cpu-261025');directory.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
original=server_state();assert original['nano_cpus']==4_000_000_000
active="from pathlib import Path; import json; print(sum(json.loads(p.read_text()).get('status') in ('queued','running','cancelling') for p in Path('/data/jobs').glob('*/status.json')))"
assert int(docker(['exec','k-aption_be-backend-1','python','-c',active]).stdout)==0
paths=['app/services/translation_normalization.py','app/services/translation_qwen.py','app/services/translation.py','app/services/translation_http.py','app/services/translation_inputs.py','app/services/translation_validation.py','scripts/evaluate_cpu_translation_threads.py']
report={'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'original':original,'source_sha256':{p:hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths},'runs':[],'order':[4,8,8,4],'limits':['Current normalizer at both CPU settings; no prompt or model change.','Saved STT replay, not full API timing.','Two full passes per CPU setting in ABBA order; no thermal or host load control.','Initial smoke repeats one failed input three times; not used for speed comparison.']}
try:
 report['smoke']=run_condition(directory,'smoke-8',8,original,(13,13,13))
 assert report['smoke']['failed']==0,'8 CPU smoke failed'
 for i,threads in enumerate(report['order'],1):
  row=run_condition(directory,f'full-{i}-{threads}',threads,original,())
  report['runs'].append(row)
  assert row['failed']==0,'Full replay failed'
finally:
 report['restoration']=configure(4,original)
 save_new(directory/'comparison.json',report)
